# Original Ahem 1.1 WOFF2

`Ahem.woff2` is a byte-identical copy of the
[Font fixture](../../../../surgeist-font/tests/fixtures/PROVENANCE.md#original-ahem-11).
It is the 1,496-byte Ahem 1.1 resource that the corpus
[base stylesheet](../../layout/browser_parity/scripts/gentest/test_base_style.css)
embeds as a data URL, retained from Taffy's pinned browser-test support. The
parity code reads these bytes so that the crate reads no file outside its own
directory.

SHA-256: `e450dd6e1bc6fb10ebc6edecef1182dcd8cad6e12e54c363ad4ba26f6b5db46c`.

License: public domain with Creative Commons Zero fallback, as stated in the
[declaration](../../../licenses/ahem/COPYING). The
[upstream README](../../../licenses/ahem/UPSTREAM-README) retains authorship and
usage information. No new font was acquired.
